title: Presenting: Arts Educators Save the World with Guest Josh Radnor

sentences.en: Welcome back to your How We Made Your Mother podcast feed.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《我们是如何创作你母亲》播客频道。

sentences.en: Today, we're presenting an appearance by our own Josh Radner
sentences.zh: 今天，我们为大家带来我们自己的乔什·拉德纳

sentences.en: on a podcast called Arts Educators Save the World,
sentences.zh: 在一档名为《艺术教育家拯救世界》播客中的访谈节目，

sentences.en: where successful artists sit in conversation with their mentors
sentences.zh: 在这档节目中，成功的艺术家与他们的导师进行对话，

sentences.en: to talk about the importance of art, arts education, and mentorship.
sentences.zh: 探讨艺术、艺术教育以及导师制的重要性。

sentences.en: I produced this podcast with my lifelong friend Erica,
sentences.zh: 我和我的多年好友埃里卡共同制作了这档播客，

sentences.en: and this is a fantastic episode with Josh and one of his teachers from NYU,
sentences.zh: 这一集非常精彩，由乔什和他在纽约大学的一位老师共同呈现，
她就是黛博拉·拉皮杜斯。

sentences.en: And next week, we've got another episode of Arts Educators Save the World for you
sentences.zh: 下周，我们将在加更栏目中为您带来《艺术教育家拯救世界》的另一集节目，

sentences.en: in our bonus slot, this time with Craig Thomas,
sentences.zh: 这一次是克雷格·托马斯
与罗布·格林伯格的对话，

sentences.en: who worked with Craig and Carter on How I Met Your Mother as,
sentences.zh: 罗布曾与克雷格和卡特合作过《老爸老妈的浪漫史》，

sentences.en: to quote Craig, the adult in the room.
sentences.zh: 用克雷格的话说，他是房间里的大人。

sentences.en: If you enjoy these episodes, please check out Arts Educators Save the World
sentences.zh: 如果您喜欢这些节目，请在各大播客平台搜索并关注《艺术教育家拯救世界》，

sentences.en: wherever you get podcasts, where guests have included
Lin-Manuel Miranda, Annalee Ashford, Cecily Strong, Bradley Whitford,
sentences.zh: 林-曼努尔·米ラン达、安娜丽·阿什福德、塞西莉·斯特朗、布莱德利·惠特福德、

sentences.en: Jonathan Groff, Billy Eichner, and many, many others.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森·格罗夫、比利·艾希纳以及许多许多其他人。

sentences.en: One of the great things about Deb is she's one of the funniest people I know,
sentences.zh: 黛布最棒的一点在于，她是我认识的最有趣的人之一，

sentences.en: and her humor was so disarming.
sentences.zh: 她的幽默总是那么平易近人、卸除防备。

sentences.en: I remember being in her class, and it didn't feel like I needed to decode anything.
sentences.zh: 我记得在上她的课时，感觉完全不需要去费力解读什么。

sentences.en: It felt like, oh, I know how to do this.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像是，哦，我知道该怎么做了。

sentences.en: We sing, and we try to communicate the depth and text and meaning of a song.
sentences.zh: 我们歌唱，并试图传达一首歌的深度、歌词和内涵。

sentences.en: There was just something clear and welcoming about her style and her class.
sentences.zh: 她的风格和课堂里有一种说不出的清晰与温馨。

sentences.en: I felt at home, and I felt like I had a right to be there.
sentences.zh: 我感到宾至如归，觉得自己有权利留在这里。

sentences.en: This is Arts Educators Save the World, where successful artists and their mentors talk
sentences.zh: 这里是《艺术教育家拯救世界》，在这里，成功的艺术家和他们的导师们将共同探讨

sentences.en: about how arts education transformed their lives.
sentences.zh: 艺术教育是如何改变他们的生活的。

sentences.en: I'm Erica Rosenfeld-Halverson, and here we are,
sentences.zh: 我是埃里卡·罗森费尔德-哈尔弗森，我们又见面了，

sentences.zh: 继续探讨关于艺术家与导师的话题。
